about: Committed coverage baseline read by eval-coverage-contract.test.js. Every list is a ratchet: a new gap fails
the contract until it is closed or recorded here, and an entry that is closed (now captured, now checked, now
graded) or no longer exists fails it until the entry is removed.
uncaptured: registered genpage prompts with no stored fixture, so neither runner grades them.
unscored: per-eval genpage expectations with no registered check in either runner, so they report SKIP.
status is "deferred" when an offline check could grade the stored artifacts, "manual" when a person has to
neverGraded: registered checks that return SKIP on every fixture they run on, so they verify nothing yet.
eval null is a common assertion. Every entry's reason says why it is not graded yet, and what would close it.

unscored.text: Phase 1 (Planner): Plan mentions mock data, D3.js for chart, DataGrid for customers table, KPI cards
unscored.reason: Gradeable from the plan text, but the captured run 2-mock-dashboard-real shows real drift: its plan draws the chart in inline SVG and uses Table, not D3.js and DataGrid (references/rules.md: D3.js for all charts). A correct check fails that capture, the runners have no expected-failure mark, and a check loosened to accept SVG or Table would hide the drift.

unscored.text: Phase 5 (Page Builder): Generated .tsx fetches usersettings via dataApi.retrieveRow and uses formatDate/formatNumber/formatCurrency helpers
unscored.reason: Gradeable from the page source, but the only eval-13 fixture, 13-contact-localization, shows real drift: it never reads usersettings and formats nothing through formatDate/formatNumber/formatCurrency (references/localization.md makes the usersettings read mandatory). A correct check fails it, and the runners have no expected-failure mark.

unscored.text: Phase 2b (Entity Builder): cr_ticket is provisioned with choice columns via provision-entities.js input JSON; picklist options include {value,label} pairs
unscored.reason: The expectation names an input shape provision-entities.js refuses: its input validation reads each Choice option as a label (a string, or a map of LCID to label) and rejects a {label, value} object ('label' is not an LCID); values are assigned 100000000 + index. It needs rewording to the label form together with agents/genpage-entity-builder.md Step 4, which documents the same refused shape, and the only eval-15 fixture, 15-support-tickets-real, did not capture its input JSON.

neverGraded.text: For Dataverse pages with fetching, separate setState calls inside async callbacks are batched into a single setData(...) call (Rule 14)
neverGraded.reason: Gradeable from the page source, but a correct check fails historical fixtures 1-account-card-gallery, 7-job-candidates-new-entities, 11-recruitment-multi-page and 13-contact-localization: each sets its rows in try and calls setLoading(false) in finally, the pattern Rule 14 names as an intermediate render. Rule 14 predates them, so it is real drift; the runners have no expected-failure mark, and skipping historical fixtures would hide it.

neverGraded.text: Phase 5 (Page Builder): Generated code has no unnecessary complexity matching the 'clean and minimal' request
neverGraded.reason: Subjective: whether code is more complex than a clean and minimal request needs is a judgement, not a property the source can be checked for; the Layer 3 UX rubric scores it.
